_comment: Manual tradingSymbol -> investorgain.com GMP-page slug mapping. DR-3 forbids matching across sources by company name — investorgain's table only exposes company name + this slug (from each row's <a href>), so the slug is what we match on. It's far more precise than the earlier free-text substring approach and is still hand-audited: add one entry per issue as it appears in the live GMP table's link href (e.g. href="/gmp/varmora-granito-ipo/1852/" -> slug "varmora-granito-ipo/1852"). An issue with no entry here is skipped (fetcher returns null), never fuzzy-matched.
